statement: SDL dispatches Wii MotionPlus gyro only when cached active mode is non-NONE, an extension payload contains at least six bytes, the invalid-data flag in its sixth byte is clear, and the gyro-versus-pass-through discriminator in sixth-byte bit 1 is set. Reporting also requires enabled sensors. The decoder combines three 14-bit raw angular fields around center 8192, applies fast/slow scale bits and axis remapping, then emits SDL_SENSOR_GYRO. Varying application-side semantic rotations alone does not prove the host received a gyro-marked packet.

applicability.revision: SDL 3.2.10, SDL 3.4.18 and SDL main at pinned October 2026 source commits; no retail Wii measurement
